intro: Panama is a presidential republic that has controlled its canal since 1999.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for a single five-year term; José Raúl Mulino took office in 2024. The National Assembly has 71 members.

chapters.title: Canal politics
text: In 2025 the US president's demands to take back the canal caused tension.
